# human-render — the human skin over the frozen fs3 envelope

A standalone PROTOTYPE (shelf item, not wired into flowspace3). v1 answers in
JSON only — workshop 003 D5, Jordan's call. This is the fast-follow made ready
in advance: the same envelope, rendered for a person at a terminal, in the
results.smart: The standalone `human-render` prototype renders the frozen `fs3-core` `Envelope` either as byte-for-byte JSON or as terminal-friendly Rich-style output, ensuring the human view derives only from machine-received data. It supports search, doctor, error, status, and generic fallback surfaces, with presentation selected by flags and TTY detection while ANSI color policy is handled centrally by `anstream`. The crate is intentionally isolated from other flowspace3 components and excludes live progress, paging, watching, and theming configuration.
